name: AC Uninstallation
tagline: Gas-safe AC removal for moves and renovations
headline: Removed With Care, Ready for Its Next Wall
summary: Most air conditioners are not killed by age. They are killed the day someone rips them off the wall with the gas still in the lines. Our technicians pump the refrigerant back into the outdoor unit, cap every pipe, and remove both units carefully, so your AC arrives at its next wall ready to cool.

symptoms.title: House move on the calendar
symptoms.description: Packers can carry an AC, but only a technician can disconnect it without venting the gas that makes it work.

symptoms.title: Renovation starting soon
symptoms.description: Masonry dust and paint mist wreck open coils, so the unit should come off the wall before the first hammer swings.

symptoms.title: Replacing an old unit
symptoms.description: An outgoing AC holds exchange value only if its refrigerant circuit survives the removal intact.

symptoms.title: Civil or wall work planned
symptoms.description: When the outdoor unit sits where scaffolding or waterproofing crews need to be, it must come down cleanly and go back up later.

symptoms.title: A quote that skips pump-down
symptoms.description: If a remover plans to simply cut the copper lines, the refrigerant escapes and the compressor pays the price at reinstall.

faqs.question: What exactly is a pump-down?
faqs.answer: Pump-down means running the compressor briefly to pull all the refrigerant back into the outdoor unit before the pipes are disconnected. Skip it, and the gas vents into the room the moment the lines are cut. The AC would then need a fresh R32 charge of ₹2,500-3,500 before it cools again. Done properly, the charge travels with the unit at no extra cost.

faqs.question: Can our packers and movers just take the AC down?
faqs.answer: They can lift it, but most moving crews carry no gas-recovery tools, so the refrigerant is lost and moisture enters the open lines. That moisture corrodes the circuit from the inside and shortens compressor life. Book the technician removal a day before the packing crew arrives, and the AC travels sealed.

faqs.question: How long does an uninstallation take?
faqs.answer: A split AC typically takes 45 to 90 minutes including the pump-down, and a window unit less. We offer same-day slots and a 60-90 minute reach in covered areas, which matters when the moving truck is already booked.

faqs.question: Will the AC need a gas top-up at the new house?
faqs.answer: Not if the removal was done properly, because a full pump-down and capped pipes preserve the charge and keep Chennai's humid air out of the lines. If a previous removal has already cost you gas, we will say so plainly and quote a top-up from ₹1,499 before touching anything.

faqs.question: Do you handle the reinstallation too?
faqs.answer: Yes. The uninstall and reinstall bundle starts at ₹2,199 plus materials such as extra copper piping. The same labelling and capped lines from the removal make the refit faster, and we position the outdoor unit with Chennai's sea air and monsoon splash in mind.
